components.name: Settings tabs
components.description: Flat tab row with an underlined selected state.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#383e46)}.ds-tabs button{padding:9px 0 11px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#b8c1cc);font:500 13px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs [aria-selected=true]{color:var(--text,#f0f3f6);border-bottom-color:var(--accent,#afd6f2)}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:#fff}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#afd6f2);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A factual record of the approved restrained interface, with the robot scene leading and configuration disclosed on demand.
dos: Preserve keyboard focus and meaningful state labels.
